gaps.lead: Someone should test this water regularly.
gaps.explanation: should test → should be tested (modal + be + participle).

gaps.lead: I last saw him in March.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect with since + point in time: haven't seen him since (March).

gaps.lead: 'I broke the window,' said the boy.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing (optionally 'to'): admitted breaking / admitted to breaking.

gaps.lead: Although he is rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — the inverted concession pattern.

gaps.lead: That's the school where my mother teaches.
gaps.explanation: the school in which my mother teaches = where my mother teaches.

gaps.lead: You can't park here — it's forbidden.
gaps.explanation: mustn't = it is forbidden (not: don't have to).
